description: Record something a customer did (e.g. signed_up, cart_abandoned, trial_ending), by user_id and/or phone. It starts or advances any active automation listening for that event. external_id (their Mixpanel distinct_id, when not user_id) puts the texts it starts on their Mixpanel profile.

external_id.description: Optional. The person's id in your analytics tool (their Mixpanel distinct_id; `mixpanel_distinct_id` is accepted too), when it is not user_id. Kept on the event as mixpanel_distinct_id; texts the event starts land on that profile in Mixpanel. Without it, user_id is used.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A unique key for this call: a retry with the same key is recorded once.

properties.description: Up to 20 scalar values; usable as merge fields and in conditions.

user_id.description: Your id for the person. Sent with phone, it links the two, so later events need only user_id

name: track_event
title: Track event
